test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper gains 20% when he sells an article at a 20% discount on its marked price. If the cost price of the article is reduced by 20% and he wants to earn a profit of 26%, then how much per cent discount should he give on the same marked price of the article?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the marked price be Rs 100

Selling price = Rs 100 - Rs 20 = Rs 80

Cost price = 80over 120 × 100 = 200over 3

New cost price = 200over 3 × 80over 100 = 160over 3

Selling price for 26% profit = 126over 100 × 160over 3 = Rs 67.2

Discount needed = Rs 100 - Rs 67.2 = Rs 32.8

Discount % = 32.8over 100 × 100 = 32.8%

∴ **Total discount needed would be 32.8%.**
